Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a Commission meeting

  Code of Ethics

As City of Irwindale Senior Citizen Commissioners, our fundamental duty is to serve the public good. We are committed
to the principle of an efficient and professional local government. We will be exemplary in obeying the letter and spirit
of Local, State and Federal laws and City policies affecting the operation of the government and in our private life. We
will be independent and impartial in our judgment and actions.

We will work for the common good of the City of Irwindale community and not for any private or personal interest. We
will endeavor to treat all people with respect and civility. We will commit to observe the highest standards of morality
and integrity, and to faithfully discharge the duties of our office regardless of personal consideration. We shall refrain
from abusive conduct, personal charges or verbal attacks upon the character or motives of others.

We will inform ourselves on public issues, listen attentively to public discussions before the body, and focus on the
business at hand. We will base our decisions on the merit and substance of that business. We will be fair and equitable
in all actions, claims or transactions. We shall not use our official position to influence government decisions in which
we have a financial interest or where we have a personal relationship that could present a conflict of interest, or create
a perception of a conflict of interest.

We shall not take advantage of services or opportunities for personal gain by virtue of our public office that are not
available to the public in general. We shall refrain from accepting gifts, favors or promises of future benefit that might
compromise our independence of judgment or action or give the appearance of being compromised.

We will behave in a manner that does not bring discredit or embarrassment to the City of Irwindale. We will be honest
in thought and deed in both our personal and official lives.

Ultimate responsibility for complying with this Code of Ethics rests with the individual elected official. In addition to any
other penalty as provided by law, violation of this Code of Ethics may be used as a basis for disciplinary action or censure
of a Commissioner.

These things we hereby pledge to do in the interest and purposes for which our government has been established.

 From:  Armando Hegdahl, Management Analyst
 Issue:  Commission Reorganization

Recommendation:

Commissioners elect Chair and Vice-Chair

Administrative Action:

 Submitted by:

 Armando Hegdahl, Management Analyst
 (626) 430-2201

 Reviewed I Approved by:

 Theresa Olivares, Assistant City Manager

Background and Analysis:

It is appropriate at this time to reorganize the Irwindale Senior Citizen Commission, including
the selection of a Chair and Vice-Chair. In order to complete the reorganization, the following
procedures is suggested:

  1) The Management Analyst opens the nomination period for the office of Chair. Any
  Commissioner may make a nomination; no second to the nomination is required.
  2) After receiving all nominations, the Management Analyst closes the nomination
  period.
  3) The Management Analyst then conducts the roll call vote to determine who will serve
  as Chair. If more than one nomination is made, a roll call vote is conducted for each
  nomination, beginning with the first nomination received , until a Chair is selected by
  majority vote.
  4) The Chair then opens the nomination period for Vice-Chair in the same manner as
  above.
  5) After receiving all nominations, the Chair then closes the nomination period.

  Page 1
   6) The Chair then conducts the roll call vote to determine who will serve as Vice-Chair.
  If more than one nomination is made, a roll call vote is conducted for each
  nomination, beginning with the first nomination received , until a Vice-Chair is selected
  by majority vote.

Fiscal Impact:

None.

MANAGER UPDATE  Senior Center Manager Beltran provided the following update:

  1) A St. Patrick's Day Meal event will be held on March 11, with
  contactless, curbside meal pickups being scheduled between
  3:30 p.m. and 5:30 p.m.

  2) Bingo on Zoom will be held on February 24 from 1 to 2 p.m.
  Interested individuals that wish to participate in the March Bingo
  activities can already begin registering.
  3) Seniors can also begin registering for the "Moving and Grooving"
  classes that will take place between March 4 and 15.
  4) "Monday Mindfulness" is a new 8-week class that will take place
  every 2nd and 4th Monday of the month via Zoom .
  5) "Rock Painting" classes will begin this Thursday, and will be held
  on the last Thursday of the month.
  6) Crafts via Zoom will be held on March 10, from 1 pm to 2 pm, and
  is limited to the first eight signups. Intergenerational Crafts via
  Zoom will be held on March 29.
  7) The Birthday Breakfast event is scheduled for March 25 and is
  limited to the first 80 signups.
  8) The Intergenerational Book Club is scheduled to meet via Zoom
  on February 23.
  9) A "What's Brewing?" Zoom social club will be held soon where
  individuals and staff can simply chitchat over coffee.
  1O)Another social Zoom activity with staff will take place where
  participants can join in a variety of different activities.

MANAGER UPDATE  Assistant City Manager Olivares provided the following update:

  1) She appreciated the commissioners' willingness to stand by and
  wait until the commission meetings were resumed , and thanked
  them for their eagerness in participating in meeting over Zoom.
  2) She also indicated that staff looks forward to resuming Senior
  Center events and activities at some point in the future, when it is
  safe for staff and patrons to engage in them, although the format
  will likely be very different from what we are accustomed . Senior
  Center staff is doing everything it can to offer programs via Zoom.

To:  Honorable Chair and Commission Members
 From :  Theresa Olivares, Assistant City Manager
 Issue:  Senior Center Fitness Equipment Update

Recommendation:

That the Senior Citizen Commission receive an update on the Senior Center Fitness
Equipment Project.

Administrative Action:

Submitted by: Eloise Beltran

Department Head I Manager
(626) 430-2286

 Reviewed I Approved by:

Theresa Olivares, Assistant City Manager

Background and Analysis:

1. The Heathy Initiative Grant, which was awarded by the California Parks and
  Recreation Society (CPRS) to the Irwindale Recreation Department to purchase and
  install four (4) fitness equipment at Jardin de Roca Skate Park also included four (4)
  fitness equipment to be placed in the side patio at the Senior Center.

2. To qualify for the Healthy Initiative Grant, the City of Irwindale had to agree to be a
  National Demonstration Site. A National Demonstration site demonstrates the
  importance of community health and wellness by raising awareness and creating a
  positive atmosphere for health and fitness . Data is collected to illustrate community
  vitality in social-emotional, environmental, health, community, engagement, public
  service and educational opportunities. To be a part of this program , the City was
  required to choose from specific packages that ensured the fitness equipment covered
  Balance, Aerobics, Core, and Muscle Training .

  Page 1
   a. Senior Center utilized option 2 A
  i. Balance- Assisted Balance Walk
  ii. Aerobics - Step-up Fitness Station
  iii. Core - Sit Up Station
  iv.  Muscle - Lap-Pull Down

  Please see the attached photos of the Senior Center Fitness Equipment.

3. The Senior Center Fitness Equipment Project requires a canopy over the equipment.
  The plans, which included the canopy, were approved in January 2021 . On
  Wednesday, January 27, 2021 , GameTime obtained the required Building and
  Safety permits.
4. At this time, Senior Center does not have a time as to when this project will begin.
  GameTime is currently waiting for the canopy to arrive to begin the project. We have
  an anticipated date of March 24 when the canopy will be shipped to GameTime. We
  will update you on this project when we receive more information .

  2. Photos of the Fitness Equipment
